title: HeaderValueTyped sum type forces caller match on a variant that is statically determined by HeaderForm
description:
header_typed.rs:197-275 — `parse_header_typed(form: HeaderForm, raw: &[u8]) -> HeaderValueTyped` deterministically returns the variant matching `form`:

    HeaderForm::Raw       ⟶ HeaderValueTyped::Raw(String)
    HeaderForm::Addresses ⟶ HeaderValueTyped::Addresses(Vec<EmailAddress>)
    HeaderForm::Date      ⟶ HeaderValueTyped::DateTime(Option<HeaderDateTime>)
    ...

The Rust type system does not encode this invariant. Every caller wanting to extract the Date result must write:

    let dt = match parse_header_typed(HeaderForm::Date, raw) {
        HeaderValueTyped::DateTime(dt) => dt,
        _ => unreachable!("parse_header_typed(Date, _) always returns DateTime"),
    };

Or `if let HeaderValueTyped::DateTime(dt) = ...`. Every caller pays the boilerplate. The `unreachable!()` arm is dead code that has to be written and maintained anyway.

Caller-facing consequence: 100% of typed-use sites write defensive code for impossible variants. This is the textbook "API forces every caller to write the same boilerplate" pattern.

Fix options:

a) Per-form entry points (sibling to the sum-type one):
    pub fn parse_addresses(raw: &[u8]) -> Vec<EmailAddress>
    pub fn parse_grouped_addresses(raw: &[u8]) -> Vec<AddressGroup>
    pub fn parse_message_ids(raw: &[u8]) -> Vec<String>
    pub fn parse_date(raw: &[u8]) -> Option<HeaderDateTime>
    pub fn parse_urls(raw: &[u8]) -> Vec<String>
    pub fn parse_raw(raw: &[u8]) -> String

Keep parse_header_typed for callers that dispatch dynamically (JMAP-style "header:Subject:asAddresses" properties). Both forms compose.

b) Convenience accessors on HeaderValueTyped: `into_addresses() -> Option<Vec<EmailAddress>>`, etc. Less type-safe than (a) but a smaller surface change.

(a) is the cleaner contract. The current sum-type API is necessary for dynamic dispatch and should stay; per-form helpers are the missing layer for callers that know the form statically.
close_reason: Added: (.13) six per-form entry points — parse_raw, parse_addresses, parse_grouped_addresses, parse_message_ids, parse_date, parse_urls — each returns the variant payload type directly, eliminating boilerplate match-on-variant at every call site. The sum-type parse_header_typed remains for callers that dispatch dynamically. (.27) HeaderForm now has impl Display emitting the RFC 8621 §4.1.2 form-tokens (asRaw, asAddresses, asGroupedAddresses, asMessageIds, asDate, asURLs), impl FromStr accepting that exact set with a new UnknownHeaderForm error type, and an as_jmap_token() method. asText is intentionally rejected by FromStr until MIME-o2c.28 lands.
